note: General self-care only, each item traceable to its source (NHS pages, NHS hospital trusts, Asthma + Lung UK, British Heart Foundation). No medicines, inhalers or nebulizers here: the patient's own prescription is surfaced separately and always comes first. Order of care: try these steps, recheck, see a doctor if not better; EMERGENCY gets none of this.

bhf_chest_pain.title: British Heart Foundation - What to do with chest pain

cuh_breathlessness.title: Cambridge University Hospitals (NHS) - Ten tips for managing breathlessness

items.en: Drink plenty of water.
items.hi: Paani piyiye.

items.en: Rest and try to relax — stress can make headaches worse.
items.hi: Thoda aaram kijiye aur relax karne ki koshish kijiye — tension se sir dard badh sakta hai.

items.en: Take a break from screens.
items.hi: Kuch der phone aur screen se aankhon ko aaram dijiye.

items.en: Don't skip meals.
items.hi: Khana skip mat kijiye.

items.en: Get lots of rest.
items.hi: Achhe se aaram kijiye.

items.en: Drink plenty of fluids — water is best.
items.hi: Khoob paani aur taral cheezein lijiye — paani sabse achha hai.

items.en: Get some fresh air.
items.hi: Thodi taaza hawa mein baithiye.

items.en: Take small, regular sips of a cold drink.
items.hi: Thanda paani thoda-thoda karke ghoont mein piyiye.

items.en: Avoid strong-smelling, fried or greasy food.
items.hi: Tez khushboo wala, tala hua ya bahut tel wala khana mat khaiye.

items.en: Take small, regular sips of water to avoid dehydration.
items.hi: Paani ki kami na ho, isliye thoda-thoda paani ghoont mein piyiye.

items.en: Rest.
items.hi: Aaram kijiye.

items.en: Lie down until the dizziness passes, then get up slowly.
items.hi: Chakkar jaane tak let jaiye, phir dheere se uthiye.

items.en: Drink plenty of fluids, especially water.
items.hi: Paani piyiye.

items.en: Don't drive or use machinery while dizzy.
items.hi: Chakkar ke dauraan gaadi mat chalaiye aur machine ka kaam mat kijiye.

items.en: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth or pad.
items.hi: Saaf kapde ya pad se ghaav par zor se dabaiye.

items.en: Sit down and lean forward a little, resting your elbows on your knees.
items.hi: Baith jaiye aur thoda aage jhuk kar kohniyan ghutno par tika lijiye.

items.en: Pursed-lip breathing: breathe in gently through your nose, then breathe out slowly through pursed lips, as if blowing out a candle.
items.hi: Naak se dheere saans lijiye, phir hont gol karke — jaise mombatti bujhate hain — munh se dheere-dheere saans chhodiye.

items.en: Breathe slowly from your tummy: in through your nose, letting your tummy move out, not your chest.
items.hi: Pet se aaram se saans lijiye — naak se, aur saans lete waqt pet bahar aaye, chhati nahi.

items.en: Cool your face — sit near a fan or an open window.
items.hi: Chehre par thandi hawa lagne dijiye — pankhe ya khuli khidki ke paas baithiye.

items.en: Try to stay calm and relax your shoulders — worry makes breathlessness feel worse.
items.hi: Ghabraiye nahi, kandhe dheele chhodiye — ghabrahat se saans aur phoolti hai.

items.en: Stop what you're doing, sit down and rest.
items.hi: Jo kar rahe hain use rok dijiye, baith jaiye aur aaram kijiye.

items.en: Try to rest and relax.
items.hi: Aaram kijiye aur relax karne ki koshish kijiye.

items.en: A heat pad or a covered hot water bottle on your tummy may help.
items.hi: Pet par heat pad ya kapde mein lipti garam paani ki bottle rakhne se aaram mil sakta hai.

items.en: Eat and drink slowly, and have smaller, more frequent meals.
items.hi: Dheere-dheere khaiye-piyiye, aur thoda-thoda karke kai baar khaiye.

items.en: Rest.
items.hi: Aaram kijiye.

items.en: Drink plenty of fluids.
items.hi: Khoob paani aur taral cheezein lijiye.

items.en: A hot lemon and honey drink may help (not for babies under 1 year).
items.hi: Garam paani mein nimbu aur shahad lene se aaram mil sakta hai (1 saal se chhote bachchon ko shahad nahi).

items.en: Pat or tap the skin instead of scratching it.
items.hi: Khujlaiye mat — halke se thapthapaiye.

items.en: Hold something cool on it, like a damp towel.
items.hi: Us jagah par geela thanda kapda rakhiye.

items.en: Wear loose cotton clothes, and avoid perfumed soaps and creams.
items.hi: Dheele cotton ke kapde pahniye, aur khushboo wale sabun ya cream mat lagaiye.
